from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

# The set of categories is derived from the task definition, so we can use Literal.
AllowedCategories = Literal[
    '行政行为 - 行政受理',
    '行政行为 - 行政处罚',
    '执行案由 - 其他案由',
    '非刑事赔偿 - 错误执行赔偿',
    '行政行为 - 行政许可',
    '产品责任纠纷',
    '执行案由 - 对下级法院执行异议裁定的复议',
    '危害公共安全罪',
    '行政行为 - 行政强制',
    '民事案由 - 合同，无因管理，不当得利纠纷',
    '侵犯公民人身权利，民主权利罪',
    '用益物权纠纷',
    '海事海商纠纷'
]

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document with its identified category."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document, e.g., 《判决文书 1》")
    category: AllowedCategories | None = Field(description="The legal case category this document belongs to, matching the task list")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short text snippet supporting the category assignment")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentRecord] = Field(description="List of all judgment documents extracted and categorized")
